_meta.note: URLs marked urlVerified=false should be validated before heavy use. Quizlet links point to the subject page because individual sets change maintainers over time.

items.title: IELTS.org · Sample test questions
items.description: Official free mocks released by IELTS. Academic version with audio and answer keys.

items.title: Cambridge IELTS 17 (Academic)
items.description: Cambridge's official set of 4 full mocks. Audio + answer keys + Writing and Speaking samples. Paid, book or digital.

items.title: Cambridge IELTS 18 (Academic)
items.description: Latest edition in the series. 4 additional mocks. Best saved for the Mock-test intensive phase.

items.title: British Council · Take IELTS practice tests
items.description: Free section-level mocks with scoring. Solid timing-drill complement.

items.title: Write & Improve (Cambridge)
items.description: Submit Writing Task 1 and Task 2; get an estimated band score plus automated feedback on cohesion, grammar and lexis. Free with an account.

items.title: IELTS Liz · Writing Task 2 model answers
items.description: Library of band-9 model answers with structural and lexical breakdowns for discussion, opinion and problem-solution prompts.

items.title: IELTS Simon · Writing band 9 samples
items.description: Ex-examiner. Task 1 and Task 2 samples with teacher-style commentary. Particularly useful for unpacking band 7+ criteria.

items.title: IELTS Liz · Speaking samples (band 7-9)
items.description: Bank of Part 1, Part 2 and Part 3 with band 7-9 candidate recordings plus analysis of fluency, coherence and lexical range.

items.title: E2 IELTS · YouTube Speaking practice
items.description: Channel with Speaking Part 2 and Part 3 mock interviews, answer breakdowns and band-raising techniques. Great for hearing timing and intonation.

items.title: IELTS Simon · Speaking lessons
items.description: Idiomatic phrases, connectors and mental templates for Part 3. Strong source of natural, advanced lexis.

items.title: BBC Learning English · 6 Minute English
items.description: Short episodes on varied topics with transcripts. Ideal for shadowing and passive UK-accent exposure.

items.title: BBC Sounds
items.description: BBC audio hub: podcasts, live radio and archives. UK-accent focus across regional varieties.

items.title: BBC Radio 4 · In Our Time
items.description: Weekly academic programme on history, science and philosophy. Dense vocabulary, formal register — perfect prep for Listening Section 4.

items.title: BBC Learning English · The English We Speak
items.description: British idioms and everyday expressions. Useful for Speaking and for Listening Sections 1-2.

items.title: Quizlet · Academic Word List (subject)
items.description: Community sets of the 570 AWL words grouped into 10 sublists. Look for one with flashcards + audio.

items.title: Quizlet · IELTS vocabulary (subject)
items.description: Broad catalogue of IELTS sets by topic (environment, education, technology). Useful complement to the in-app SRS.

items.title: IELTS Liz · Vocabulary by topic
items.description: Topic-based lists with academic collocations for Task 2 and Speaking Part 3.

items.title: British Council Peru · IELTS
items.description: Official test centre in Peru. Registration, available dates, venues (Lima, Arequipa) and formats (paper-based, computer-based).

items.title: IDP Peru · IELTS
items.description: The other official provider. Same exam, different dates. Handy if British Council has no convenient slot.
